::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 6th [1876?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mary Yonge Society/7
:::

My dear [Mrs Elgie](people/person_475.qmd)

Many thanks for this dear little note.  I always did think your Girls most thoroughly good and conscientious, and I think their love of home is the best and happiest thing for the place and people.  I wonder when those lawyers will finish off and let you take possession.[^1]  I hope it is all right about [Helena Dugay](people/person_447.qmd)

your affectionate
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps of the new incumbency of Otterbourne, so that the  [Rev. Walter Elgie](people/person_478.qmd) became Vicar rather than curate.
